item.title: Major economic boost has been announced for Co. Longford
item.description: A major economic boost for Longford has been announced. US-based Technimark has been granted planning permission to create up to 120 new jobs in the region. Technimark is a multinational specialising in precision-made plastic components and packaging for sectors including healthcare. The new employment opportunities will be an expansion to the existing 147 staff. It plans to develop a major new facility at the former Eir depot in Templemichael Business Park. item.title: Concern expressed over increasing number of crashes in South Leitrim
item.description: Concern has been expressed locally over the ever-increasing number of road crashes in south Leitrim. item.description: There were over 40 patients waiting for a bed at local hospitals this morning. That's according to the INMO's latest trolley watch report. item.title: Hodson Bay Group to open €15m eco-tourism retreat
item.description: The Hodson Bay Group is to open a new €15m eco-tourism retreat this Summer as it reports revenues increasing by 2.5pc to just over €60m for last year. Group CEO, Padraig Sugrue said today that the group’s Hyatt Centric hotel in Dublin city was its best performing hotel in the group recording €17.5m in revenues for the 12 months to the end of February last. item.title: Government urged to introduce new grant measures
item.description: A local TD has called on the government to introduce stage payments under the Vacant Properties Refurbishment Grant. The grant provides funding to people who are looking to refurbish a vacant or derelict home. item.title: Longford and Leitrim get Ladies football season off the ground
item.description: An intriguing fixture lies in store as Longford prepare to entertain Leitrim in Sunday’s live game. Longford finished third from bottom last year while Leitrim reached the semi-finals, where they lost out to Antrim. Leitrim will be one of the promotion favourites but they won’t get anything easy on their visit to the Midlands. item.title: Roscommon fall to Sligo in FBD
item.description: Sligo produced a late comeback to down Roscommon and land the FBD League plate. A late surge saw Sligo wrap-up the pre-season competition with a 2-14 to 1-18 win in the Connacht centre of excellence. Sligo offered more throughout and led 1-7 to 1-5 at half-time. Rob Heneghan’s 21st minute goal dragging Roscommon back into the game. Advertisement Lee Deignan having put Sligo into a 1-4 to three-point lead after 16 minutes. However, Sligo responded better after the restart. Deignan (0-2), Darragh
